prior_status: Positive nonnegative single-use credit telescope proved only for the equal-magnitude quadratic bent one-point-defect family; extension to unequal prime factors was open.
bounded_objective: Derive the general first-step data/selector order-swap functional and determine whether some physical coordinate must have nonnegative credit for arbitrary one-point defects or unequal prime tensors.
method: Exact Fourier restriction pairing, analytic AND-family asymptotics, a rigorous rational-log interval certificate, exhaustive small Boolean corroboration, and mandatory bent/addressing/near-tensor controls.
mathematical_delta: Derived an exact pairwise formula for every Boolean one-point defect and refuted existential nonnegative first-step credit at unchanged hypotheses. Every coordinate of q_n has negative credit for n>=3 with asymptotic -2n*4^(-n), and every coordinate of the unequal q_4 tensor q_5 witness is rigorously negative.

primary_literature_checked.source: Gonzalez--MacManus--Pereyra, Further evidence towards the Fourier Entropy-Influence conjecture
primary_literature_checked.scope: well-chosen splitting variables, wrong-variable controls, and stopping trees

primary_literature_checked.source: Wan--Wright--Wu, Decision Trees, Protocols, and the Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture
O'Donnell--Tan, A composition theorem for the Fourier Entropy-Influence conjecture

mandatory_controls.rare_restriction: independent activation scales and preserves credit sign
mandatory_controls.near_tensor: q_4 tensor q_5 has every coordinate negative
mandatory_controls.addressing: r=2,3 address coordinates positive and data coordinates negative

validation.arithmetic: exact Fraction Walsh relations; rigorous rational atanh-series log intervals; binary64 only for exhaustive sign-pattern corroboration

remaining_obstacle: The positive bent payment cannot be universalized as a nonnegative first-step currency. A signed multi-step global potential with nonreuse and complete terminal payment remains unproved.
next_action: On q_n, compute the complete signed multi-level credit telescope and test whether the accumulated negative n*delta^2 term is paid exactly by terminal selector mass or a nonreused influence decrement; then test the resulting potential on addressing and the bent family.
